answer.summary: Linguistic pattern analysis in scientific discourse requires verifiable source text before NLP-based semantic inference can be trusted
answer.content: The analysis of syntactic motifs in arXiv preprints is currently blocked by absence of raw text data; without access to the abstracts and introductions of preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876, no NLP processing or semantic clustering can be performed with confidence. The request for cross-preprint consistency and contextual variation lacks actionable input due to missing source content. A bounded revision is necessary to establish data accessibility prior to analysis.
